name: smwgraphics-sma2-smm2-luigi-hybrid-smas-luigi-tweaks
title: SMA2 + SMM2 Luigi Hybrid (+ SMAS Luigi tweaks)
description:
An opposite to QuadFactor's SMA2 Mario, this is my take on how SMA2 Luigi would look if he was more consistent with base SMW Mario, taking some cues from SMAS, SMM2, and Beta Luigi. I've also included a tweaked SMAS Luigi that makes him cleaner in some areas as well as give him a more unique head shape in small form.



Includes:

-Revamped SMA2 Luigi (with alt mustache)

-Same as above with but with SMAS Poses

-Revamped SMAS Luigi (with alt Mario Poses)

-GFX00, 22, and 24 where needed



I recommend you use them with patches that fix tile errors in the vanilla game (specifically the first cape flight frame and small victory pose while riding Yoshi)



You can also make whatever palette you prefer for them, but my take on SMA2 Luigi is that he'd have the same overalls and skin color as Mario, since it is that way in SMA2.



Both Luigis also have a small p-speed jump frame in an unused tile.
